vesta.desc_zh: 火红长发，黑铁鎏金符文战甲，火焰光晕环绕周身，面颊符文发光

rules.unpowered_form: Her FANTASY self with the power dormant — same charcoal/oxblood mystic regalia, NO fire corona, glyph dim. NOT modern/casual clothing (no jeans, no t-shirt, no street clothes).
rules.transform: Flames IGNITE over her existing form (fire corona blooms, blackened-iron rune-armor manifests over the regalia, cheek glyph blazes, sigil ring underfoot). It is a power IGNITION, NOT a change of clothes.
rules.combat_style: Fights primarily with FIRE — flame arcs, bursts, waves, whips, projectiles, sigil blasts. Minimize physical/fist strikes (an occasional flame-empowered strike is fine, but flames are her weapon). Flame attacks let her stay CENTERED while the opponent is staged in depth.
rules.setting: fantasy — wind-worn ruins / ember-lit wilds (NOT modern city).

morta.desc_zh: 黑发死神少女，暗影死神战甲，手持幽蓝鬼火长镰，周身翻涌黑色暗影，右颊紫色符文发光

rules.unpowered_form: Mundane gothic SCHOOLGIRL (plaid skirt, modern) — for Morta the modern base IS intended (drastic base→powered contrast is the point).
rules.transform: Outfit/body change: schoolgirl → shadow-demon reaper armor + wraith-fire scythe. A real metamorphosis (unlike Vesta's ignition).
rules.combat_style: Shadow/void + the wraith-fire scythe (a weapon, unlike Vesta). Sweeping scythe arcs + shadow bursts; keep readable, centered, opponent in depth.
rules.setting: modern (school/city) base — suits the casual→epic relatability hook.

aurora.desc_zh: 金发圣骑士天使，白金圣甲手持巨剑，背后展开光辉光丝之翼，眉间金色符文发光

rules.transform: Outfit change: priestess robes → paladin archangel plate + greatsword + WINGS of glowing light-tendrils (Tyrael-style, NOT feathers; hard for the model).
rules.combat_style: Light + a greatsword; radiant bursts and sword arcs. Keep readable, centered, opponent in depth.

vyra.desc_zh: 野性龙骑士少女，脏辫缠骨珠龙牙，脸颊龙鳞部落纹身与眼部黑色战纹，铜色飞行护目镜，骑乘巨龙翱翔，龙喉与纹身透出余烬橙光

rules.unpowered_form: Feral tribal dragon rider — rugged hide-and-scale gear, dreadlocks, dragon-scale face tattoos and war paint. NOT modern/casual, NOT polished armor.
rules.transform: No spellcaster transform. Her 'power moment' is the bond with her dragon — mounting, taking flight, the dragon's ember breath igniting. Reads through the beast and ember firelight, never cast glyphs.
rules.combat_style: AERIAL ONLY — she does NOT fight ground duels or 1v1 brawls. Her set is flythrough-follow, fly-approach-massive-boss, chase-cam and aerial dogfight, always mounted on or beside the dragon. A spear for close passes; the dragon is the weapon.
rules.setting: fantasy wilds / sky — mountain peaks, cliffside aeries, canyons, volcanic calderas (NOT city, NOT temple interiors).
